description: This file contains internal function declarations, object definitions, and structures related to ASN.1 processing for PKCS12 and associated cryptographic bags, certificates, and related data structures. It appears to be part of a generated ASN.1 handling library for cryptographic data structures used in secure communications.

classes.name: ASN1_PFX
classes.description: Represents the ASN.1 Sequence structure for PFX, containing version, authSafe, and optional macData.

classes.name: ASN1_MACDATA
classes.description: Represents the MAC Data ASN.1 structure with digest info, salt, and iterations.

classes.name: ASN1_AUTHENTICATEDSAFE
classes.description: Represents a sequence of ContentInfo objects, part of the authenticated safe in PKCS12.

classes.name: ASN1_SAFECONTENTS
classes.description: Sequence of SafeBag objects containing cryptographic bags.

classes.name: ASN1_SAFEBAG
classes.description: A cryptographic SafeBag containing bag ID, value, and optional attributes.

classes.name: ASN1_PKCS12ATTRIBUTES
classes.description: Set of PKCS12Attribute objects representing attributes associated with SafeBags.

classes.name: ASN1_PKCS12ATTRIBUTE
classes.description: Attribute object used within PKCS12 facilities.

classes.name: ASN1_CERTBAG
classes.description: A sequence representing a certificate bag with type OID and value.

classes.name: ASN1_CERTVALUE
classes.description: Choice structure representing an encoded certificate in base64 or octet string form.

classes.name: ASN1_CRLBAG
classes.description: CRL (Certificate Revocation List) bag with type and value.

classes.name: ASN1_SECRETBAG
classes.description: Sequence representing a secret, with type OID and value.

classes.name: ASN1_BAGVALUE
classes.description: Choice structure for different bag content types, including keys, certificates, CRLs, secrets, or safe contents.
